noun_definition: beginningofchathistory refers to the initial segment of chat history that should be displayed in various room types, not limited to self-direct messages (selfDMs).
room type refers to the different categories of chat rooms in which the beginningOfChatHistory feature should be displayed, beyond just self-direct messages (selfDMs).
selfdm refers to a type of chat room specifically designed for one-on-one conversations with oneself, as opposed to other room types.
